abstract.text: Integrate Quadrascan to generate 3D models and anthropometric measurements of a subject using a guided, SwiftUI-based scanning flow.

inlineContent.text: Quadrascan SDK exposes a SwiftUI view that interactively guides a person through a process that collects images of them and returns a 3D model and anthropometric measurements of that person. To use the SDK, add it to your project, provide a configuration, and present the scan view. The scan completes with a result object containing output based on your configuration.
Quadrascan requires camera access. Add this key to your app’s Info.plist:
The SDK requests camera access when capture begins. iOS terminates an app that requests camera access without this key.
The photo picker flow uses the system photo picker, which runs outside your app and returns only the photos the user selects. It doesn’t require photo library authorization or an
key.
